description.value:
Traits Signal

The once-per-round limit on spending Encore becomes twice per round. This is two spends per round shared among all your allies, not two each. Each spend is unchanged: 1 Encore, a reroll of one failed check, no action cost, a fortune effect. No single check can be rerolled twice.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 (no pool/spend-tracking to raise a limit on) and SB2 (the spend itself is a reroll). No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either. No Reroll rule-element key exists anywhere in Foundry's pf2e system (confirmed: zero hits for "key": "Reroll" in pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/, and the full 34-entry rule-element key list has no reroll key -- RollTwice is a different, pre-result advantage/disadvantage mechanic). Encore's core primitive, "spend 1 Encore to reroll a failed check," is a post-result reroll and is categorically unbuildable as a standing rule element.
